read_orc: read an ORC file from a local path or URL and return a pandas DataFrame
read_orc_columns: read specific columns from an ORC file by passing a columns list to read_orc
read_orc_dtype_backend: read an ORC file with nullable dtype backend using numpy_nullable or pyarrow
to_orc: write a pandas DataFrame to ORC format with a default RangeIndex
to_orc_bytes: write a pandas DataFrame to ORC format and return bytes when path is None
